tasks.prompt:
Write a JavaScript function `mergeIntervals(list)` that takes an array of [start, end] integer pairs (start ≤ end, in any order) and returns a new array of merged intervals sorted by start. Two intervals merge when they overlap or share an endpoint (e.g. [1,3] and [3,5] give [1,5]).

Return only the function in a single ```js code block. No imports, no I/O, no explanation.

check.ref: function mergeIntervals(list){const s=list.map(x=>[x[0],x[1]]).sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]||a[1]-b[1]);const o=[];for(const x of s){const c=o[o.length-1];if(c&&x[0]<=c[1])c[1]=Math.max(c[1],x[1]);else o.push(x);}return o;}
